name: Mandell-Boisclair Justice Camp (RWU School of Law Social Justice Camp)
operator_name: Roger Williams University School of Law
description_short: A one-week day program for middle schoolers about social justice and the law, run at RWU's downtown Providence campus with a visit to the Bristol campus. Campers learn from practicing attorneys, Rhode Island judges and community leaders.
activities: Mock arguments at the RI State House
Meeting attorneys, judges and community leaders
Studying democracy, elections and voting rights
Meeting candidates for local and state office
